problem_text:
A regional sales representative must conduct a promotional tour to 11 key retail outlets:
Outlet Alpha: Positioned at grid reference (111,117)
Outlet Beta: Positioned at grid reference (183,84)
Outlet Gamma: Positioned at grid reference (98,43)

Outlet Kappa: Positioned at grid reference (53,47)
Outlet Lambda: Positioned at grid reference (113,89)

Iota to Lambda: 65.0 minutes
Kappa to Lambda: 73.2 minutes

Due to ongoing construction, there is no permissible direct route connecting Outlet Alpha and Outlet Beta.
Furthermore, owing to contractual agreements with local distributors, the final itinerary must incorporate exactly one of the following two key connections: the link between Outlet Beta and Outlet Gamma, or the link between Outlet Gamma and Outlet Delta.

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient circular tour that visits each outlet precisely once before returning to the initial location.
